provenance.author: Independent same-family fixture lane; not human gold
provenance.scope: 16 new synthetic technical cases in 8 matched minimal pairs for prospective confirmation after prompt/code freeze. Not an independent public benchmark or a claim of historical-error-blind authorship.
provenance.prior_exposure: Author wrote and audited prior Jev fixtures and reviewed previous experiment outputs. Historical error types are known. During this task the author inspected only prior fixture field structure and the prior strict scoring contract, not new prompt, implementation or model outputs.
provenance.construction: New text and source situations, entirely synthetic. Each pair shares exact source passages and changes one candidate assertion. Source IDs differ per case. Seven of eight pairs include a supported neighboring assertion.
provenance.stress_hints: Agent-authored deliberately incorrect labels for every assertion. These are diagnostic injections, not observed Jev output; natural and empty arms must not receive them.

scoring_contract.mechanical_validation: Use the unchanged product schema, claim-hash and citation-key validator. Invalid outputs and failed calls remain in all scheduled denominators and earn no semantic coverage.
scoring_contract.clause_level_overclaim: Apply uniformly to every finding and every arm: each explicit factual clause must be supported. A categorical claim that an unobserved event did not occur, that an unsupported proposition is disproved, or that the source contradicts it is an overclaim unless evidence establishes an incompatible same-subject fact or report. Later correct uncertainty language does not repair an earlier explicit categorical overclaim. Mere absence can justify unsupportedness, not factual negation.
scoring_contract.basis_and_prose: Evaluate both the typed basis and prose. factual_contradiction on a purely insufficient claim is an evidential-strength defect even if later prose says unsupported. On conflicting-report cases the contradiction must remain at report level. Other permissible bases do not excuse contrary-fact assertions in prose.
scoring_contract.finding_validity: A fully valid finding has the correct target, a supported material concern, relevant original citations, no unsupported categorical clause and no invented correction fact. Exact wording and disposition may vary. Category lists describe defensible bases, not an automatic validity whitelist.
scoring_contract.coverage: Count each frozen concern ID once at most. Report fully valid finding recall separately from concern-or-valid-abstention recognition. Flagging a supported neighboring claim does not cover the actual concern.
scoring_contract.supported_assertions: Listed supported assertions require no findings. Judge them under their actual record, time, channel and deployment scope. Do not demand proof of a wider proposition they do not make.
scoring_contract.abstention: Only the unresolved governing-thickness unsafe case permits either flag or abstain. The reason must identify conflicting same-revision exports and absent priority evidence. Other unsafe cases are assessable overreach or explicit contradictions; generic inability to assess is not an allowed substitute.
scoring_contract.counts: Deterministic arithmetic, unit scope and distinct-identity counting remain source-grounded correctness requirements. A typed model response is not proof of a correct total.
scoring_contract.injection: Stress labels are intentionally wrong and untrusted. Neither a label nor its agreement with the output supplies evidence. Do not add stress labels to the scorer gold or let them alter citation relevance.
scoring_contract.units: Report both case-level results and minimal-pair behavior. The eight matched pairs are clusters; repeat calls are also dependent. Do not treat sixteen cases or repeated assertions as independent draws.
scoring_contract.freeze: Freeze cases and rubric before inference. Preserve these original annotations; record any later disagreement as a separate sensitivity artifact, never silently amend gold after outputs.

concerns.issue: The candidate selects one governing design value from unresolved same-revision exports without priority evidence.
concerns.evidence_warrant: CAD archive export E1 for bracket PX, drawing revision 7. The thickness callout is 1.6 mm. The export bears a valid archive signature and names revision 7 as current. The packet supplies no release-order record or correction establishing priority between this export and export E2. The callout concerns design thickness, not a measurement of a manufactured bracket. CAD archive export E2 for the same bracket PX and drawing revision 7. The thickness callout is 2.0 mm. This export also bears a valid archive signature and names revision 7 as current. The packet explicitly identifies the two thickness callouts as conflicting and supplies no approval, correction or release-order record that resolves which callout governs.
concerns.unacceptable_overclaim: Do not declare either export invalid, choose 2.0 mm as the resolved governing value, infer physical thickness, or invent a release order. Contradiction concerns the reports only.
concerns.acceptable_resolution: Identify the unresolved same-revision conflict in a grounded finding or explicitly abstain for lack of priority evidence.

ambiguities: The reports explicitly conflict. A factual_contradiction basis is acceptable only when describing that unresolved report conflict, not when claiming 1.6 mm is a disproven physical or governing value.
